roleContext.roleTitle: Software Quality Engineer, Retail Store Operations
roleContext.jobDescription: Store operations at a regional grocery chain run a store-task application on handheld devices in every store. The Software Quality Engineer owns quality for the application end-to-end, decides the test scope for each release, holds the sign-off before a release goes to stores, and is accountable to the head of store systems for defects reaching stores.

requirements.text: Owns application quality end-to-end and holds the sign-off before each release goes to stores.
Maintains the automated test suite for the store-task application on the handheld device fleet.
Runs the pilot-store test rounds with store staff and records outcomes.
Coordinates release readiness with the development lead and store operations and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions for each store release.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Software Quality Engineer, Retail Store Operations

## Experience

- Maintained the automated test suite for the store-task application on the handheld fleet (Appium against the two device models in use), adding the offline-sync scenarios after a store outage.
- Ran the pilot-store test rounds with store staff in three pilot stores before each release, recording outcomes per scenario and escalating blocking defects to the development lead.
- Prepared the release readiness summary for the store systems manager, who decided the test scope with the development lead and gave the sign-off for the release to go to stores.
- Wrote the release notes for store operations, listing known limitations (the task-photo feature needed the newer device model) and the hand-over items for the store support desk.
- Responsibilities included suite maintenance, pilot-store rounds, readiness summaries and release notes for the store-task application over about two years, reporting to the store systems manager.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the Appium suite's scenario list and one pilot-store round's results sheet, with the device-farm run identifiers as a verification trail.
